question.plainText: Given below are two statements: Statement I: Among Zn, Mn, Sc and Cu, the energy required to remove the third valence electron is highest for Zn and lowest for Sc. Statement II: The correct order of the following complexes in terms of CFSE is [CoH_2O_6]^{2+} < [CoH_2O_6]^{3+} < [Coen_3]^{3+}. In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.latex: Both Statement I and Statement II are true
options.unicode: Both Statement I and Statement II are true
options.plainText: Both Statement I and Statement II are true

options.latex: Both Statement I and Statement II are false
options.unicode: Both Statement I and Statement II are false
options.plainText: Both Statement I and Statement II are false

options.latex: Statement I is true but Statement II is false
options.unicode: Statement I is true but Statement II is false
options.plainText: Statement I is true but Statement II is false

options.latex: Statement I is false but Statement II is true
options.unicode: Statement I is false but Statement II is true
options.plainText: Statement I is false but Statement II is true

explanation.latex:
Statement I: For Zn (atomic number 30), the configuration is $[Ar] 3d^{10} 4s^2$. After removing 2 electrons, $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ becomes $[Ar] 3d^{10}$, an extremely stable, fully-filled d-subshell. Removing the third electron ($IE_3$) requires very high energy. Sc (atomic number 21) is $[Ar] 3d^1 4s^2$. After losing 2 electrons, $\text{Sc}^{2+}$ is $[Ar] 3d^1$. Removing the third electron achieves the stable noble gas configuration $[Ar]$, so it has the lowest $IE_3$. Thus, Statement I is true.

Statement II: CFSE ($\Delta_0$) is influenced by the oxidation state of the central metal and the field strength of the ligands. For identical ligands ($H_2O$), CFSE is higher for a higher oxidation state ($Co^{3+} > Co^{2+}$). Additionally, ethylenediamine (en) is a strong field ligand compared to the weak field ligand $H_2O$. Thus, $[Co(en)_3]^{3+}$ splits the d-orbitals more. Therefore, the order is $[Co(H_2O)_6]^{2+} < [Co(H_2O)_6]^{3+} < [Co(en)_3]^{3+}$. Statement II is true.
